IEC 62443 zones: Z1 control (PLC, Axioline I/O, transmitters) · Z1.5 data (edge computer) · Z1T Thread mesh (Pods, DTLS/mTLS) · Z2 management · customer IT isolated · life safety hardwired (sheet 05)
ZONE 1 — CONTROL (VLAN 20, 10.20.0.0/24 · no default route, no WAN)
ZONE 1T — BEN MESH (Thread 2.4 GHz, fd00:ben::/64 · DTLS join · mTLS MQTT · stub network, no route out)
Modbus TCP / OPC UA server · Modbus RTU master
RS UNI (RS-485) · local bus from the PLC
VLAN 20 ports · PoE for Pod E · port security
fed from the 24 VDC panel supply
meter gateway 10.20.0.20 · polled by the edge
power meters · UPS · cooling unit controllers · Pod E slaves
wired industrial transmitters: UL 61010-1 · shielded pairs, shields landed in the panel only · Class 2
edge never commands a valve or a unit
Thread 802.15.4 mesh · self-healing · Pods route for each other
two Pods per rack + two per unit · MQTT publish only to fd00:ben::1 · SNTP from the edge · Pod E additionally: Cat6 to the switch (PoE) and RS-485 to the PLC
7 in panel or screen at the door
separate NIC, separate cable · only ports marked MGMT
edge API reachable; PLC, Pods, meters are NOT reachable from here
their servers, their fiber, their rules
NO cable to the controls switch. NO controller interface here.
shared with BEN only: power, cooling, the room
edge computer initiates · nothing listens on WAN
customer runs: ben-vpn-support.sh up / down · auto-off 48 h
inbound over tunnel: SSH + API only

RS-485 Modbus RTU · optional outbound VPN

Leak / door / EPO / fire — monitor only
